subject: general
question: How many countries share land boundaries with India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Seven**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There are seven countries that share a land border with India namely Pakistan, Afghanistan, Nepal, China, Bangladesh, Bhutan, and Myanmar.
 
• Bangladesh shares the longest border with India as it is surrounded by India on three sides. It is said to be the 5th largest land border in the world.
 
• Afghanistan shares the least border with India among the other 6 countries.
 
• China is the largest country that shares a border with India.
 
• Bhutan is the smallest country that shares a border with India.
